answer: I would anchor trust in POAP attendance set from five events. With badges from five real events over a year, a single shale check quietly prices out anyone trying to run a hundred names at once. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since badges from five real events over a year takes calendar time as well as money — and the grove is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The cipher grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
